name: coding-support-bridge
description: HTTP bridge for Coding Support Overlay to call AI APIs (Gemini, OpenAI, DeepSeek, etc.)

codingSupport.apiKey.description: API key for your AI provider (Gemini, OpenAI, DeepSeek, etc.)

codingSupport.provider.description: API provider format. 'auto' detects from model name.

codingSupport.model.description: Model name. Examples: gemini-2.5-flash | gemini-2.5-pro | gpt-4o | deepseek-chat | claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022

codingSupport.apiBaseUrl.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible base URL (include /v1). Overrides the provider URL. Example (9Router): http://localhost:20128/v1

codingSupport.visionSupported.description: Enable image input (vision). Supported by: Gemini 1.5+, GPT-4o, Claude 3+. Disable for text-only models.
